_comment: Template for awowlab.config.json, the file that says where your build points. CMake copies it on the first configure and fills settings_key with a random value; edit the copy, never commit it. Each builder uses their own WarcraftLogs client id, repositories and signing key; see docs/BUILD-OPTIONS.md. Only the public half of the signing key goes here. The private key stays outside the repository, named by the AWOWLAB_SIGNING_KEY environment variable (tools/release/SIGNING.md).
